content: Sera i garalawa utuniye
Sera yawaliye le molamolao theghathegha hothaŋarɨ hoiwo na umbopirɨ (127).
Va i mare Kiriyat Aba (mbaŋake thɨ uno idae Hebron) Kenan e tɨne, na Eibraham i nuwatharɨ laghɨye moli le mareko kaiwae.
Amba Eibraham i roiteta levo riwae na ve thuweŋgiya Het gharɨgharɨniye na iŋa,
“Bwabwariya ghino ya yaku e tɨnemike. Hu vakuneŋa thelauke vuvura e ghino na mbala ya beku lo wevokowe.”
Het gharɨgharɨniye thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa,

“Amalana, wo u vandeŋeime. Wo worawa ghan midi na ghen randeviva vurɨvurɨghegheniye regha. The ghabubu thovuye regha ina gheke u tuthi na u bekwa len wevowe. Maa lolo regha ina gheke ne i vaghareghara le ghabubu e ghen na u bekwa len wevowe.”
Amba Eibraham i yondovirɨ na i kururu e maranji,
na iŋa, “Thoŋgo hu warariŋa ya bekwa lo wevoke e lemi thelauke, ghino e idaŋgu wo hu utu weimi Eipron Soha nariye, ghino kaiwaŋgu
na mbala i vakuneŋa eŋge maŋgavarɨ regha e ghino ina Makpela. Maŋgavarɨko iyako amalaghɨniyewe ina ele umako mbothiye. Ŋgoroŋga modae, ne ya vamoda ŋgoreiye na lo ghamba beku kaka e tɨnemike.”

E mbaŋako iyako Eipron vambe ina gheko weiyaŋgiya ghauneko i vandeŋe Eibraham le utuko. Giyagiyako wolaghɨye methɨ rakamenako weiyaŋgi e ghamba mevathavatha ŋgora ghamba ruko, e maranji Eipron i thombeya Eibraham le renuwaŋako iŋa,
“Amalana, maa valɨkaiwae mbema ya vatomwe eŋge maŋgavarɨ, mbema weiye vara thelauna iya inanɨnawe. Wouneke wolaghɨye e maranji ya vatomwe e ghen na u bekwa len wevowe.”
Eibraham mbowo i kururuva Het gharɨgharɨniye e maranji,
na i dage weya Eipron gheuneko e maranji iŋa, “Wo u vandeŋeŋgo. Mbemane ya vamoda vara thelauko iyako. U wovatha lo renuwaŋake na mbala ya wo lo wevo na va wobeku gheko.”
Eipron i gonjoghawe iŋa,

“Wo u vandeŋeŋgo, wo giya laghɨye, thelauko modae le ghanaghanagha silva gethɨseriyevarɨ (400). Ko buda kaiwae ghen na ghino ra rerenuwaŋa modo kaiwae. U vamodo e ghino na mbema u wa eŋge na vo bekwa len wevona.”

Eibraham i warariŋa iya modoko Eipron me woraŋgiyako. I wa ve sikeliya silvama gethɨseriyevarɨ (400) ŋgoreiya Eipron me woraŋgiyama gharɨgharɨko wolaghɨye e maranji. Thɨ sikeli ŋgoreiya rakunekune na ra vavamodo lenji vakatha e maket.
Iyako ra thuwe va ŋgoroŋga na Eipron le thelau weiye maŋgavarɨ na umbwaumbwa nanji e tɨne ina Makpela, Memri valɨvaŋga i vorovoro, va i vakuneŋa
weya Eibraham na kaero le ghamba mbaro, le ghavalɨ Het e maranji iya vathɨ raka e ghamba mevathavathako.
Vamodoko e ghereiye, Eibraham i bekwa levo Sera e maŋgavarɨko. Maŋgavarɨko ina Hebron Kenan e tɨne Memri valɨvaŋga i vorovoro.
Iyako ra thuwe ŋgoroŋga na Eibraham va i wo thelauko iyako weiye maŋgavarɨko ina e tɨne na le ghabubu. Het loloniye i vakuneŋawe.
